Commercial LPG Prices Rise, GST and Pension Rules Change from November 1

Effective November 1, 2026, commercial LPG cylinder prices have increased by ₹10, with the new price for a commercial cylinder being ₹2,820. Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) prices also saw a rise of ₹1.37 per litre. Changes in Goods and Services Tax (GST) rules, pension regulations, and mobile phone regulations are also set to take effect. Some reports indicate that milk, curd, and alcohol may become more expensive due to these changes.
